description: Backend Core Services - Implement 5 missing service files (InterviewsService, QuestionsService, AnswersService, EvaluationsService, RecommendationsService) that power the interview lifecycle. These services orchestrate interview creation, AI question generation, answer submission with evaluation, and final recommendations. All entities and DTOs already exist; this implements the business logic layer.
steps: Create backend/src/interviews/interviews.service.ts with @Injectable decorator, inject Repository<Interview>, Repository<JobRole>, Repository<Resume>, Repository<StudentProfile> from profiles/entities/profile.entity, QuestionsService, RecommendationsService

Implement create(userId, dto): validate jobRoleId exists via jobRoleRepository.findOne, if dto.resumeId validate resume exists and userId matches (ForbiddenException if not), create Interview with status=CREATED, totalQuestions=dto.questionCount||10, answeredQuestions=0, save and return

Implement startInterview(userId, id): load interview with relations ['jobRole', 'resume', 'user.profile'], ownership check userId===interview.userId, status check ===CREATED, update status=IN_PROGRESS and startedAt=new Date(), load profile via profileRepository.findOne({ where: { user_id: userId } }), call questionsService.generateQuestions(interview, interview.resume, profile, interview.jobRole), save interview, return { interview, firstQuestion: questions[0] }. On AI error keep status=CREATED and rethrow

Implement completeInterview(userId, id): load with relations ['answers', 'answers.evaluation'], ownership check, status check ===IN_PROGRESS, calculate overallScore as average of all evaluation.score, update status=COMPLETED and completedAt and overallScore, save, call recommendationsService.generateRecommendations(interview), return interview with recommendations
Implement findOne(userId, id): load with ['jobRole', 'questions', 'questions.answer', 'questions.answer.evaluation'], ownership check, return
Implement getInterviewQuestions(userId, id): load with ['questions', 'questions.answer'], ownership check, map to {...question, isAnswered: !!question.answer}, return

Implement getInterviewReport(userId, id): load with ['jobRole', 'questions', 'questions.answer', 'questions.answer.evaluation', 'recommendations'], ownership check, verify status===COMPLETED else BadRequestException, return

Implement findAll(userId, page, limit, status?): createQueryBuilder with where userId, if status provided add andWhere, orderBy createdAt DESC, leftJoinAndSelect jobRole, paginate with skip=(page-1)*limit and take=limit, return { interviews, total, page, totalPages }
Create backend/src/interviews/questions.service.ts with @Injectable, inject Repository<InterviewQuestion>, HttpService from @nestjs/axios, ConfigService

Implement generateQuestions(interview, resume, profile, jobRole): build payload { job_role: jobRole.title, interview_type: interview.interviewType.toLowerCase(), difficulty: interview.difficulty.toLowerCase(), question_count: interview.totalQuestions, resume_text: resume?.extractedText || null, skills: [...(profile?.technical_skills || []), ...(profile?.programming_languages || [])] }. POST to ${AI_SERVICE_URL}/questions/generate using httpService.post().pipe(map(res => res.data), catchError). Map response.questions to InterviewQuestion entities with questionNumber=index+1, questionText=item.question, questionCategory=item.topic, expectedPoints=item.expected_key_points, interviewId=interview.id. Bulk save and return. Wrap in try-catch, throw BadRequestException on failure
Create backend/src/interviews/answers.service.ts with @Injectable, inject Repository<InterviewAnswer>, Repository<Interview>, Repository<InterviewQuestion>, EvaluationsService

Implement submitAnswer(userId, interviewId, dto): load interview with ownership check, status check ===IN_PROGRESS, load question where id=dto.questionId and interviewId=interviewId (NotFoundException if not found), check for existing answer where questionId=dto.questionId (ConflictException if exists), create and save InterviewAnswer { interviewId, questionId: dto.questionId, answerText: dto.answerText, timeTakenSeconds: dto.timeTakenSeconds }, call evaluationsService.evaluateAnswer(answer, question, interview), increment interview.answeredQuestions and save, find next unanswered question using createQueryBuilder leftJoin answer where answer.id IS NULL orderBy questionNumber ASC getOne, return { answer, evaluation, nextQuestion: nextQuestion||null, isCompleted: interview.answeredQuestions >= interview.totalQuestions }
Create backend/src/interviews/evaluations.service.ts with @Injectable, inject Repository<Evaluation>, HttpService, ConfigService

Implement evaluateAnswer(answer, question, interview): build payload { question: question.questionText, question_type: interview.interviewType.toLowerCase(), difficulty: interview.difficulty.toLowerCase(), student_answer: answer.answerText, expected_key_points: question.expectedPoints || [] }. POST to ${AI_SERVICE_URL}/evaluation/evaluate with retry(3). Map response: score=overall_score, feedback=detailed_feedback, strengths=strengths, weaknesses=areas_for_improvement, relevanceScore=breakdown.relevance/100, accuracyScore=breakdown.technical_accuracy/100, completenessScore=breakdown.completeness/100, clarityScore=breakdown.clarity/100. Create and save Evaluation { answerId: answer.id, ...mapped }. On all retries failed save fallback { answerId: answer.id, score: 50, feedback: 'Evaluation temporarily unavailable. Please review manually.', strengths: [], weaknesses: [], relevanceScore: 0.5, accuracyScore: 0.5, completenessScore: 0.5, clarityScore: 0.5 }. Return saved evaluation
Create backend/src/interviews/recommendations.service.ts with @Injectable, inject Repository<Recommendation>, Repository<InterviewAnswer>, HttpService, ConfigService

Implement generateRecommendations(interview): load answers where interviewId=interview.id with relations ['evaluation', 'question'], build payload { evaluations: answers.map(a => ({ question: a.question.questionText, answer: a.answerText, score: a.evaluation.score, strengths: a.evaluation.strengths, weaknesses: a.evaluation.weaknesses, category: a.question.questionCategory })) }. POST to ${AI_SERVICE_URL}/recommendations/generate. On success map to Recommendation { interviewId: interview.id, strengths: response.overall_strengths, weaknesses: response.overall_weaknesses, topicsToImprove: response.topics_to_improve, overallFeedback: response.overall_feedback }. On failure generate basic: collect unique strengths/weaknesses from evaluations, topicsToImprove=categories where avg score < 60, overallFeedback='Based on {N} questions, average {avgScore}%. Focus on: {topicsToImprove.join}'. Save and return recommendation
acceptance_criteria: All 5 service files created with @Injectable decorators and proper constructor injection
InterviewsService implements all 7 methods with ownership checks and status validation
QuestionsService calls AI service at /questions/generate and maps response to entities
AnswersService implements submitAnswer with duplicate detection and next question logic
EvaluationsService implements evaluateAnswer with 3 retries and fallback on failure
RecommendationsService calls AI service and has fallback aggregation logic
StudentProfile accessed via snake_case properties (profile.technical_skills, profile.programming_languages)
All AI service calls use HttpService from @nestjs/axios with proper error handling
Services throw appropriate exceptions (NotFoundException, ForbiddenException, BadRequestException, ConflictException)
verification: cd backend && npm run build — compiles without TypeScript errors
cd backend && npm run start:dev — server starts and logs 'Nest application successfully started'
Check logs for any module initialization errors related to interviews module
